auto_triage.fall_protocol: Check for injury, assess consciousness, call 911 if unresponsive. Check for spinal injury. Do not move if neck/back pain.
auto_triage.bleeding_protocol: Apply direct pressure, elevate if possible, call 911 if severe. Use tourniquet if arterial bleeding and >2 inches from joint.
auto_triage.seizure_protocol: Clear area, do not restrain, time seizure, call 911 if >5 minutes or multiple seizures. Place on side after seizure.
auto_triage.cardiac_protocol: Start CPR if unresponsive and no pulse. Call 911 immediately. Use AED if available. Continue until help arrives.
auto_triage.respiratory_protocol: Check airway, breathing, circulation. Administer rescue breaths if needed. Call 911 if severe distress.
auto_triage.hypoxia_protocol: Administer oxygen if available. Check airway obstruction. Call 911 if SpO2 < 85%.
auto_triage.tachycardia_protocol: Monitor closely. Call 911 if HR > 180 with symptoms. Check for shock, dehydration, cardiac issues.
auto_triage.tachypnea_protocol: Monitor breathing. Call 911 if RR > 30 with distress. Check for respiratory infection, asthma, cardiac issues.
